# KoalaCast: complete product facts

Canonical site: https://cast.koalastuff.net/
Source: https://github.com/Shik3i/KoalaCast
License: MIT

## Direct answers

### What is KoalaCast?

KoalaCast is a free, open-source, privacy-first podcast player for the web. It works without an account and stores listening data locally by default.

### Does KoalaCast synchronize between devices?

Synchronization is optional. Signed-in listeners can synchronize subscriptions, queue state, playback progress, preferences and listening statistics between their devices.

### Does KoalaCast publish listening history?

No. Private listening history is not public. Community statistics are aggregated only from accounts that separately opt in. Participation is disabled by default and can be revoked.

### Can KoalaCast use any podcast RSS feed?

KoalaCast can search podcast directories and can ingest a compatible public podcast RSS URL directly. Publisher-provided chapters and transcripts are supported when present in the feed.

### Can KoalaCast be self-hosted?

Yes. The repository contains the SvelteKit web client, Go API, SQLite persistence, Docker build and OpenAPI contract needed for self-hosting.

## Feature inventory

- Podcast discovery by language and category
- Podcast-directory search and direct RSS subscription
- Local subscriptions, favorites, queue and playback progress
- Optional account synchronization
- Adjustable playback speed
- Per-podcast speed, intro skip, outro skip and auto-queue controls
- Sleep timer, silence trimming and volume boost
- Publisher-provided chapters and transcripts
- Personal listening statistics
- Separately opt-in aggregate community statistics and rankings
- OPML import and export
- Light, dark and system appearance modes
- Multiple selectable color palettes
- Installable web app assets

## Privacy and data boundaries

- An account is optional.
- Local-first data remains in browser storage unless account synchronization is enabled.
- Community-statistics participation is a separate opt-in.
- Podcast audio streams from publisher infrastructure.
- KoalaCast does not use third-party behavioral analytics or advertising trackers.

Podcast titles, descriptions, episode notes, transcripts and audio belong to their respective publishers. KoalaCast is a player and catalog client, not the publisher of that material.
